en: A song, a psalm of Asaph.
Elokim, do not keep silence for Yourself; do not be silent, and do not be still, Keil.

he: כִּֽי־הִנֵּ֣ה א֭וֹיְבֶיךָ יֶהֱמָי֑וּן וּ֝מְשַׂנְאֶ֗יךָ נָ֣שְׂאוּ רֹֽאשׁ׃
en: For behold, Your enemies make a tumult; and those who hate You have lifted up the head.
Against Your people they craft a secret counsel, and they take counsel against Your hidden ones.

he: אָמְר֗וּ לְ֭כוּ וְנַכְחִידֵ֣ם מִגּ֑וֹי וְלֹֽא־יִזָּכֵ֖ר שֵֽׁם־יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל עֽוֹד׃
en: They said: Come, and let us cut them off from being a nation; and the name of Yisrael shall be remembered no more.

he: כִּ֤י נוֹעֲצ֣וּ לֵ֣ב יַחְדָּ֑ו עָ֝לֶ֗יךָ בְּרִ֣ית יִכְרֹֽתוּ׃
en: For they have consulted together with one heart; against You they make a covenant.
The tents of Edom and the Yishmaelim; Moav and the Hagrim.

he: גְּבָ֣ל וְ֭עַמּוֹן וַעֲמָלֵ֑ק פְּ֝לֶ֗שֶׁת עִם־יֹ֥שְׁבֵי צֽוֹר׃
en: Geval and Ammon and Amalek; Peleshet with the inhabitants of Tzor.

he: גַּם־אַ֭שּׁוּר נִלְוָ֣ה עִמָּ֑ם הָ֤יֽוּ־זְר֖וֹעַ לִבְנֵי־ל֣וֹט סֶֽלָה׃
en: Also Ashur is joined with them; they have been an arm to the children of Lot. Selah.

he: עֲשֵֽׂה־לָהֶ֥ם כְּמִדְיָ֑ן כְּֽסִיסְרָ֥א כְ֝יָבִ֗ין בְּנַ֣חַל קִישֽׁוֹן׃
en: Do to them as to Midyan; as to Sisera, as to Yavin, at the brook Kishon.
They were destroyed at Ein-Dor; they became as dung for the earth.

he: שִׁיתֵ֣מוֹ נְ֭דִיבֵימוֹ כְּעֹרֵ֣ב וְכִזְאֵ֑ב וּֽכְזֶ֥בַח וּ֝כְצַלְמֻנָּ֗ע כׇּל־נְסִיכֵֽימוֹ׃
en: Make their nobles like Orev and like Zeev; and like Zevach and like Tzalmuna, all their princes.

he: אֲשֶׁ֣ר אָ֭מְרוּ נִ֣ירְשָׁה לָּ֑נוּ אֵ֝֗ת נְא֣וֹת אֱלֹהִֽים׃
en: Who said: Let us take for ourselves the pastures of Elokim.
My Elokim, make them like the whirling dust; like stubble before the wind.
As a fire burns the forest, and as a flame kindles the mountains.
So pursue them with Your tempest, and with Your storm terrify them.

he: מַלֵּ֣א פְנֵיהֶ֣ם קָל֑וֹן וִיבַקְשׁ֖וּ שִׁמְךָ֣ יְהֹוָֽה׃
en: Fill their faces with shame; and let them seek Your name, Havayah.
Let them be ashamed and terrified forever; and let them be confounded and perish.

he: וְֽיֵדְע֗וּ כִּי־אַתָּ֬ה שִׁמְךָ֣ יְהֹוָ֣ה לְבַדֶּ֑ךָ עֶ֝לְי֗וֹן עַל־כׇּל־הָאָֽרֶץ׃ {פ}
en: And let them know that You — Your name is Havayah alone — are Elyon over all the earth. [petuchah — open paragraph division]
